hypotheses.name: Gravity step-versus-compact-source shape test
hypotheses.physical_signature: At several frozen scales, compare normalized horizontal derivative width and signed east/south gradient patterns with simple extended-step and compact-source responses. Band 11 is a verified signed southward directional derivative and Band 18 a signed eastward derivative; neither should be treated as a conventional vertical-gravity derivative. Band 5 is the horizontal gradient magnitude.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An extended buried basement step could generate a coherent cross-strike response that is not captured by a single gradient maximum; rejecting compact-source-like anomalies may favor long, concealed discontinuities without using catalogue distance.
hypotheses.novelty: A 2026-10-23 review proposed the source-shape comparison, but no explicit step-versus-compact likelihood or response-ratio model was found in scripts/ or src/. H86F-GZZD and H86H-PSTD use gravity derivatives/tensors, and H86K-PSC now uses Hessian saddle/ridge topology, but none implements this explicit competing-source model comparison.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: An elongated intrusive contact, basin-margin facies change, or overlapping compact sources that happen to form a linear gradient corridor.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Highest of this remaining qualitative queue, but low-to-medium confidence; this is not a projected DTI or leaderboard score.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; requires scale-matched forward templates, verified coordinate/sign conventions, and sensitivity analysis to source depth and bandwidth.
hypotheses.falsifier: Step-source likelihood fails to outperform compact/contact controls on paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI or changes rank materially across reasonable filter scales.

hypotheses.name: Microseismic density-lineation tensor
hypotheses.physical_signature: Estimate local orientation coherence and anisotropic scale from the two seismic-density fields, then test whether persistent lineations align with independently measured geodetic shear. Freeze smoothing, orientation windows and nulls before evaluation.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: An active but unmapped structure may host aligned microseismicity without a clear surface scarp; a lineation statistic could retain geometry where amplitude/proximity summaries are diffuse.
hypotheses.novelty: A source search found seismicity used in broader strain/conduit feature fusions (including H86I-RKSC), but did not find a standalone orientation-coherence candidate built from Bands 10/16. This is checkout-scoped only; it does not establish novelty across every GEMSDOE site. Verify original band smoothing/semantics before preregistration.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Induced geothermal microseismic swarms, volcanic seismicity, and gridding/interpolation anisotropy.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low qualitative potential: the competition bands are derived density/intensity products and may be too smoothed to preserve fault-scale orientation.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium-high; requires verified layer semantics, angular nulls, fold-safe preprocessing, and comparison with both seismicity and shear-only controls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Orientation coherence does not add paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI over density-only and shear-only controls, or is unstable to plausible windows/null orientations.

hypotheses.name: Threshold-persistent conductivity neck topology
hypotheses.physical_signature: Track connectivity and neck-width persistence across a frozen conductivity-threshold filtration, and require independent strain consistency. Compare with conductivity-only, strain-only and randomized-neck controls.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: A covered fluid pathway could connect conductive regions without a mapped surface scarp; persistence of a narrow connection is intended to distinguish a corridor from a broad conductivity high.
hypotheses.novelty: H86M-CNT already tested a continuous high-pass conductivity-neck score multiplied by positive dilatation and was negative. A threshold-persistence/topological statistic is a distinct representation, but is a close refinement, not a wholly new concept. No exact threshold-filtration implementation was found in the scanned source. The H86K-CNT reserve proposal and external fleet require review before calling this novel.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Saline playa deposits, clay-rich paleochannels, or interpolation bottlenecks connecting conductive patches.
hypotheses.expected_holdout_potential: Low, with high confounding risk; only worthwhile if persistent topology adds information beyond H86M-CNT controls.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium; requires multi-threshold connected-component tracking, neck-width calibration, and spatially randomized nulls.
hypotheses.falsifier: Persistent neck features fail to beat conductivity-only and strain-only controls on paired spatial-block HOLDOUT-DTI, or topology changes materially under the frozen plausible threshold range.

required_before_any_experiment: An explicit single assigned method paragraph; current request has none.
The actual shared cached feature stack with generating-code, input-hash, preprocessing and visible-mask identity; native bands or historical hashes are not substitutes.
A shared/upstream resolution of the unchanged literal full-support witness stop; do not change support thresholds privately.
A complete current registry with an auditable policy for incompatible entries.
Freeze buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover folds; derive all catalogue features from visible faults only; mask visible fault pixels exactly.
Run isolated-feature leakage canaries before trusting a feature; AUC above 0.90 is a stop pending proof.
Use the shared evaluator, pooled DTI with alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, and 300 m triangular kernel; report evaluator, withheld-positive count, and 95% CI.
Check rank correlation on the surface before placement and 3-px overlap on final dots against the complete registry; stop above 0.90 correlation or 0.70 overlap.
Use no more than three experiments or two hours, and no weekly slot until a separate selector.
